route: The ecological Lantern Cyst is spawned by ecology site casts and built by the procedural fauna renderer. The same-named Swarm brood family uses a separate instanced presentation body.
status: Two site-cast color strains traced in source and inspected after diagnostic relocation. A public-map New Game journey reached a Charon cyst with the new geometry and shared skin, but its marked view was partly covered by the ship; an unobstructed ordinary view and a natural Veil encounter remain unverified.
